0.why: Null.hpp:39 reads the jack with getVoltage(0), and Null.cpp:208-222 scales it by 0.2 after deciding unipolar or bipolar from the voltages seen

comment: The panel colour set by a Copper is taken from the right-hand expander only: Null.cpp:81-94 calls expanderColor(getRightExpander(), ...) twice rather than once for each side, so a Copper on the left is never read. The clamp on line 221 discards its own result, so the scaled flicker value is not actually limited to ±5.
